title: Off line set up instructions IOB COB ISF etc
body:
Hi guys,

Is there a guide to understand how XDrip works without sensor (NOT how to connect)? Id like to know how it deals with and how to set up IOB, COB, predictive BG, Bolus Calculator, alarms etc before going 'live'.

Im running MM2 with Libre, OP5 android 9 with TicPro. Its my first step into CGM. Ill be transferring from MySugr so understand IOB.

WHY? I only have 2 libres because of my location through Covid 19 and I'd like to save them for if I get ill. So I'd like to learn ahead of inserting sensor how to set up (not just connect, which seems to be ok).

Thanks
